text_block_list.text:
One day, after fighting through many races 
together with Yaeno Muteki.

While cleaning my room, I noticed an 
envelope left forgotten in the corner of 
my desk.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, from the raffle. Please, feel free to 
use it.
choice_data_list: No, we said we'd use it together, right?
No, didn't we agree to use it together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...You remembered that...? Um, it was just 
a casual verbal promise, so...
choice_data_list:
Ah, but it's not for training, it's for 
hot spring therapy.

text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki mentioned doing hot spring 
training, and this was too good an 
opportunity to pass up.

"Since she trains almost too hard on a 
regular basis, I'll let her take it easy, 
as if she's on a hot spring retreat."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood. Let us take our time and 
relax.

We were blessed with clear skies on the 
day of the trip. Yaeno Muteki seemed to be 
enjoying herself as well. I could somehow 
tell from the atmosphere around her.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That felt great. My muscles have 
loosened up, and my body feels light."
choice_data_list:
Ah, my shoulders and back feel so much 
better!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono seems relieved of fatigue as 
well. Even the distortion in your 
posture...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? There's still a slight distortion……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's do a quick tidy-up.

Moving to a beach near the inn and 
stretching, Yaeno Muteki checked my 
single-leg balance and other basics.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Yes, no problem at all.
choice_data_list:
It's the opposite of usual, feels pretty 
fresh.

It's the opposite of usual, feels pretty 
fresh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed. However, I am merely putting 
to use the knowledge that you have 
bestowed upon me, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Looking back, I have learned many 
things from you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Really...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To think you guided someone as troublesome 
as me without ever giving up on me...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I truly admire such perseverance.
choice_data_list:
...I've never thought of you as 
troublesome.

text_block_list.text:
I've never found her troublesome, nor do I 
feel like I've ever had to hold back or 
endure anything.

I told her that she was always diligent 
and had always responded earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I have just realized it now. The 
reason why someone as ill-tempered as 
myself becomes entirely defanged before 
you, Trainer-dono..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...That's...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —The benevolent have no enemies.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"If you had the strongest Trainer by your 
side... Ah, everything makes sense now!"
choice_data_list: You're giving me too much credit...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nay! I object. You must become aware of 
your own worth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, everyone's gonna realize just 
how noble you are, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —No, this is bad.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, you are essential to me. 
There is no other trainer who could ever 
guide me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even if they plead on bended knee, I shall 
not yield!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……? Why are you laughing?

If they haven't noticed, I'll keep quiet. 
Because once they realize, they'll surely 
scramble to cover it up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... It seems there's some deeper 
meaning here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us perform a kata together. 
Trainer-dono, allow me to gauge your true 
feelings through our martial 
demonstration."

Even when our partnership was first 
decided, she poured her feelings into a 
martial arts kata to convey them to me.

If we can pour our feelings into it and 
convey them to each other— then bring it 
on.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —...Now, let's begin!

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Yaeno Muteki...
